title: Nairobi site coordinate standardization
description: Convert supplied WGS 84 site locations into a metric projected coordinate system for local spatial analysis.

intent.outcome: Produce a projected site-location dataset in UTM zone 37S (EPSG:32737), ready for metric distance, buffering and overlay workflows.
intent.decision_context: Prepare site coordinates for consistent local measurement and spatial analysis.

geographic_scope.description: Nairobi region and surrounding coverage appropriate to UTM zone 37S.

constraints.description: The source coordinates must be explicitly declared as EPSG:4326; coordinate order is longitude, latitude.
Output coordinates must be EPSG:32737 and must remain within the operation's valid area of use.

success_criteria: Every feature retains its identifier and properties.
The output Artifact declares EPSG:32737 and has a verified checksum.

rights_requirements: Permitted for the intended analysis and delivery.

nodes.purpose: Transform WGS 84 site locations into a projected metric CRS while preserving feature identity and attributes.

outputs.experience: A validated GeoJSON site-location dataset with EPSG:32737 coordinates, ready for downstream metric analysis.

checks.description: Output bytes match the immutable Artifact checksum.

metadata.customer_job: Prepare site locations for metric spatial analysis.
